hooks.command: log="$HOME/.claude/memory-lint.log"; if [ -f "$log" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$log")" -gt 1048576 ]; then tail -n 4000 "$log" > "$log.tmp" && mv "$log.tmp" "$log"; fi; { printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$(date -Iseconds)"; python3 "$HOME/.claude/skills/memory-lint/lint.py" "$HOME/.claude/projects/$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" | sed 's#/#-#g')/memory" --fix; } >> "$log" 2>&1 || true
